entries.name: Girabola

external_evidence.supports: Official A-League Men 2026/27 Competition Rules Summary specifies 12 clubs, 26 matches per club and 156 regular-season matches.
Official 2026/27 season guide gives the season start date (16 October 2026), participating clubs, and confirms Western United is no longer in the competition.
